_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json. The mcpServers object is the same shape other
MCP hosts use, so an existing configuration can be dropped in as-is.
confirm   (default) every call is confirmed; you may approve a tool so
you are not asked again. Use this for anything you did not
trusted   read-only tools run without asking; other calls are confirmed
once and can be approved. Tools the server marks destructive
still need the keyboard every time.
readonly  only tools the server marks read-only are exposed at all.
A server's own annotations can only make a tool look more dangerous,
never safer: they are written by the server, not by you.
